    original = ledger.os.fsync

        assert calls == ["fsync"]

def test_fsync_failure_never_exposes_an_uncommitted_refund(project, monkeypatch, phase):
    root, cfg, model, rows, _ = materialize(project)
    original = ledger.os.fsync
    count = 0
    def fail(fd):
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        if count == (1 if phase == "start" else 2):
            raise OSError("owned fsync failure")
        original(fd)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ledger.os, "fsync", fail)
    entered = []
    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="fsync"):
        with operation(root, cfg, model) as op:
            entered.append(True)
            op.finish(True)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    assert len(events) == len(rows) + (phase == "finish")
    assert entered == ([True] if phase == "finish" else [])
    if phase == "finish":
        assert state(root, cfg, model).attempts[op.invocation]["finish"] is None

def test_fresh_interpreter_crash_and_clean_restart_cannot_refund(project, after_dispatch):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    code = '''
import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
from frutlups import roadmap
from test_attempts_v2 import operation
import conftest
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); cfg=conftest.offline_config(); model=roadmap.load(root/'roadmap.yaml')
with operation(root,cfg,model):
 (root/'local_state/crash.log').write_bytes(b'owned log')
 if sys.argv[2]=='True':
  import subprocess
  subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',"print('owned child completed')"],check=True)
 os._exit(23)
'''
    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": str(Path(__file__).parent)}
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, str(root), str(after_dispatch)],
                            env=env, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
    assert result.returncode == 23, result.stderr
    (root / "local_state/crash.log").unlink()
    before = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    test_loop.git(root, "add", cfg.ledger)
    test_loop.git(root, "commit", "-qm", "preserve charged crash")
    inflated = replace(cfg, max_jobs=99999, max_wall_minutes=99999)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unresolved"):
        with operation(root, inflated, model):
            pytest.fail("redispatched")
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == before
    charged = state(root, cfg, model)
    assert charged.runs["R1"]["consumed"]["jobs"] == 1
    assert charged.runs["R1"]["consumed"]["seconds"] == 10

def test_verification_save_finish_verified_order(project, monkeypatch, failure):
    root, cfg, model, rows, write = materialize(project, "verification")
    obj = internal_loop(root, cfg, model)
    original_write, original_finish = receipt.write, _attempts.Operation.finish
    seen = []
    def save_receipt(value, path):
        assert ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)[-1].ev == ledger.Ev.attempt_started
        seen.append("save")
        if failure == "save":
            raise OSError("owned save failure")
        result = original_write(value, path)
        data = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
        assert data["schema"] == "frutlups.receipt/2"
        assert data["manifest"] == rows[2]["manifest"]
        assert "changed_files" not in data
        return result
    def finish(self, *args, **kwargs):
        assert seen == ["save"]
        seen.append("finish")
        if failure == "finish":
            raise OSError("owned finish failure")
        return original_finish(self, *args, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(receipt, "write", save_receipt)
    monkeypatch.setattr(_attempts.Operation, "finish", finish)
    item = model.milestones[0].slices[0]
    current = state(root, cfg, model).slices[item.id]
    if failure:
        with pytest.raises(loop._Stop, match="owned"):
            obj._slice(item, current, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger))
    else:
        obj._slice(item, current, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger))
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    if failure:
        assert events[-1].ev == ledger.Ev.attempt_started
        assert state(root, cfg, model).runs["R1"]["consumed"]["seconds"] == 10
    else:
        assert [e.ev.value for e in events[-3:]] == ["attempt_started", "attempt_finished", "verified"]
        assert events[-3].data["role"] == "verification"
        assert state(root, cfg, model).runs["R1"]["consumed"]["jobs"] == 0

def test_materialized_extensions_cannot_reset_chain(project, kind):
    root, cfg, model, rows, write = materialize(project)
    with operation(root, cfg, model) as first:
        first.finish(False)
    rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)]
    added = extension(write)
    if kind == "fake":
        added["authority"][0]["sha"] = "0" * 64
    elif kind == "stale":
        added["revision"] = 2
    elif kind == "reused":
        added["authority"] = rows[0]["authority"]
    save(root, cfg, rows + [added])
    if kind != "valid":
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            with operation(root, cfg, model, retry="transport", parent=first.invocation):
                pytest.fail("invalid extension dispatched")
        return
    with operation(root, cfg, model, retry="transport", parent=first.invocation) as second:
        second.finish(False)
    assert state(root, cfg, model).runs["R1"]["revision"] == 1
    rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)]
    save(root, cfg, rows + [extension(write, 2)])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="retry"):
        with operation(root, cfg, model, retry="transport", parent=second.invocation):
            pytest.fail("extension reset used transport retry")

def test_unfinished_overlap_and_safe_child_resolution_bind_new_evidence(project):
    root, cfg, model, _, write = materialize(project)
    with operation(root, cfg, model) as first:
        child = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", "print('owned completion')"],
                               capture_output=True, timeout=10)
        assert child.returncode == 0
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unresolved"):
            with operation(root, cfg, model):
                pytest.fail("overlapping operation")
    rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)]
    recovery = {**_attempts.event("attempt_finished", invocation=first.invocation, status="resolved",
        usage={"completeness": "unknown"}, reason="Human observed owned child completion",
        evidence=[write("authority/recovery.md", child.stdout)]), "by": "human"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ledger._append_operation(root, root / cfg.ledger, model, recovery)
    # Materialize the human's direct finish, without a fabricated checkpoint.
    save(root, cfg, rows + [recovery])
    assert state(root, cfg, model).runs["R1"]["consumed"]["seconds"] == 10
    with operation(root, cfg, model, retry="transport", parent=first.invocation) as retry:
        retry.finish(True)
    (root / recovery["evidence"][0]["path"]).unlink()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        state(root, cfg, model)

def test_fresh_interpreter_restart_without_replay(project, monkeypatch, phase):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    calls = []
    adapter(monkeypatch, calls, ["malformed", report()] if phase == "repair" else None)
    append = ledger._append_review
    def interrupt(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs):
        if (raw["ev"] == "artifact" and
                ((phase == "report_saved" and raw["path"].endswith("/review.md"))
                 or (phase == "proof_saved" and raw["path"].endswith("/merge.json")))):
            raise OSError("owned interruption")
        if phase == "merged" and raw["ev"] == "reviewed":
            raise OSError("owned interruption")
        if phase in ("finish", "repair") and raw["ev"] == "review_checkpoint":
            raise OSError("owned interruption")
        result = append(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs)
        if phase == "checkpoint" and raw["ev"] == "review_checkpoint":
            raise OSError("owned interruption")
        return result
    monkeypatch.setattr(ledger, "_append_review", interrupt)
    with pytest.raises(OSError, match="owned interruption"):
        step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
    before = len(calls)
    code = '''
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[2])
import conftest, test_attempts_v2 as a, test_checkpoints_v2 as c
from frutlups import roadmap, ledger
from frutlups.seats import claude, JobResult
r=Path(sys.argv[1]); cfg=conftest.offline_config(); m=roadmap.load(r/'roadmap.yaml'); calls=[]
def run(self,j,cfg):
    calls.append(j.id)
    return JobResult('completed',None,c.report(),0,.01,7,9,None,None,r/'local_state/out',r/'local_state/err',None)
claude.ClaudeSeat.run=run
s=c.step(a.internal_loop(r,cfg,m))
assert len(s.checkpoints)==2
assert sum(x['finish']['usage']['tokens_in'] for x in s.attempts.values())==7*len(s.attempts)
assert sum(e.ev==ledger.Ev.reviewed for e in ledger.read(r/cfg.ledger))==1
print(len(calls))
'''
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, str(root), str(Path(__file__).parent)],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert int(result.stdout.strip()) == (0 if phase in ("merged", "report_saved", "proof_saved") else 1)
    assert before == (2 if phase in ("repair", "merged", "report_saved", "proof_saved") else 1)

def test_routed_review_commit_and_replay(project, monkeypatch, profile):

    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    reviewed = events[-1]
    assert reviewed.ev == ledger.Ev.reviewed
    proof = events[-2].data["path"]
    paths = [reviewed.data["report"], proof, *(c["report"] for c in before.checkpoints.values())]
    assert len(paths) == 4
    assert all(p.startswith(cfg.reviews_dir + "/m001/") for p in paths)
    original = {p: (root / p).read_bytes() for p in paths}
    for path in paths:
        ignored = subprocess.run([cfg.git, "check-ignore", "--no-index", path], cwd=root,
                                 capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        assert ignored.returncode == 1, ignored.stderr
    parent = gitws.head(root)

    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0]["state"] == "completed"
    assert result[0]["scope"] == "M001-S01"
    head = gitws.head(root)
    assert head != parent
    assert test_loop.git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD^").stdout.decode().strip() == parent
    for path, body in original.items():
        assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + path).stdout == body
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()

def test_interrupted_merge_reversible_drift_group(project, monkeypatch):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    calls = []
    adapter(monkeypatch, calls)
    append = ledger._append_review
    saved_report = []
    def interrupt(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs):
        if raw["ev"] == "artifact" and raw["path"].endswith("/review.md"):
            saved_report.append(root / raw["path"])
            raise OSError("owned interruption")
        return append(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs)
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(ledger, "_append_review", interrupt)
        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="owned interruption"):
            step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
    assert len(calls) == 2, "preparation: original two routed calls"
    target = saved_report[0]
    baseline = snapshot(root, cfg, calls, "preparation")
    exercised = []
    for drift in ("report", "neighbor", "product", "runtime"):
        assert snapshot(root, cfg, calls, drift) == baseline, drift + ": pre-variant drift"
        changed = {"report": target, "neighbor": target.parent / "unbound.txt",
                   "product": root / "07_app/drift.txt"}.get(drift)
        original = changed.read_bytes() if changed is not None and changed.exists() else None
        if changed is not None:
            changed.write_bytes({"report": b"tampered", "neighbor": b"unbound", "product": b"drift"}[drift])
        obj = attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model)
        if drift == "runtime":
            obj.runtime = type("ChangedRuntime", (), {"identity": {"changed": True}})()
        prefix = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
        mutated = snapshot(root, cfg, calls, drift)
        try:
            step(obj)
        except (ValueError, loop._Stop):
            pass
        else:
            pytest.fail(drift + ": real step did not refuse")
        assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == prefix, drift + ": ledger appended"
        assert target.exists(), drift + ": lost retained report"
        assert len(calls) == 2, drift + ": redispatch"
        assert snapshot(root, cfg, calls, drift) == mutated, drift + ": refusal changed state"
        if changed is not None:
            restore_file(root, changed, original)
        del obj
        assert snapshot(root, cfg, calls, drift) == baseline, drift + ": restoration mismatch"
        exercised.append(drift)
    assert exercised == ["report", "neighbor", "product", "runtime"], "routed coverage"

def test_each_contract_component_is_independent(project, monkeypatch):
    from frutlups.seats import Role, pi
    from frutlups import gitws
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    obj = attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    state = ledger.validate_history(root, events, model)
    job = obj._job("reviewer", Role.reviewer, "prompt.md")
    raw = (root / "prompt.md").read_bytes()
    runtime = dict(obj.runtime.identity)
    def binding(config=cfg, selected=model, current_job=job, prompt=raw, identity=runtime, history=events):
        return _attempts._binding(root, config, selected, history, state, "M001-S01", 1,
                                 "reviewer", current_job, prompt, identity)
    original = binding()
    assert binding(prompt=raw+b"changed") != original
    assert binding(identity={**runtime, "sha": "1"*64}) != original
    assert binding(selected=replace(model, review_routing={k: tuple(reversed(v))
                    for k, v in model.review_routing.items()})) != original
    for field, value in (("model", "other"), ("effort", "low"), ("provider", "other")):
        config = replace(cfg, seats={**cfg.seats, "reviewer": replace(cfg.seats["reviewer"], **{field:value})})
        assert binding(config=config, current_job=replace(job, **{field:value})) != original, field
    config = replace(cfg, seats={**cfg.seats, "reviewer": replace(cfg.seats["reviewer"], adapter="pi")})
    assert binding(config=config, current_job=replace(job, adapter="pi", tools=pi.READ_TOOLS)) != original
    assert binding(current_job=replace(job, seat_name="claude_reviewer")) != original
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="tools"):
        binding(current_job=replace(job, tools=()))
    parser = root / "local_state/parser.py"
    parser.write_bytes(b"owned distinct parser")
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(claude, "__file__", str(parser))
        assert binding() != original
    witness = gitws.workspace_witness(root, executable=cfg.git)
    for key, value in (("head", "1"*40), ("index", ()), ("files", {})):
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(gitws, "workspace_witness", lambda *a, **k: {**witness, key:value})
            assert binding() != original, key
    for field, value in (("envelope", {"path":"changed.json", "sha":"1"*64}),
                         ("baseline", [{"path":"owned.txt", "kind":"added", "sha":"1"*64}])):
        rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in events]
        next(r for r in rows if r["ev"] == "prompt")[field] = value
        assert binding(history=tuple(ledger._parse_event(r) for r in rows)) != original, field

def test_completed_source_references_and_pending_finish_refuse(project, monkeypatch):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)

    append = ledger._append_review

            raise OSError("owned checkpoint interruption")
        return append(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs)

        step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))

        path = root / ref["path"]

                step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
            path.write_bytes(original)
    assert len(calls) == 1
    # A valid completed call is required: remove only the fixture's finish to
    # materialize the actual crash window after result persistence, before settlement.
    rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)]
    assert rows[-1]["ev"] == "attempt_finished"
    attempts.save(root, cfg, rows[:-1])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unresolved"):
        step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
    assert len(calls) == 1

def test_status_and_usage_conform_to_template(configured, capsys, json_mode):
    root, cfg, model = grant_project(configured)
    assert run_transitions(root, cfg, model) == loop.StopReason.done
    capsys.readouterr()
    expected = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(root / "scripts/ledger.py"), "--root", str(root), "status"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout
    code, output = invoke(capsys, "status", root)
    assert code == 0
    # Native template additionally exposes run/holistic/invocation projections.
    # Compare every line of the runner's existing status/commit surface exactly.
    expected = "\n".join(line for line in expected.splitlines()
                         if not line.startswith(("run ", "unresolved invocation: "))
                         and " holistic: " not in line) + "\n"
    assert output == expected
    options = ["--json"] if json_mode else []
    code, output = invoke(capsys, "status", root, "--usage", *options)
    assert code == 0
    if json_mode:
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in output.splitlines()]
        assert rows[0] == {"action": "status", "slice": "M001-S01", "round": 1, "step": "accepted"}
        assert rows[1] == {"action": "next", "slice": None}
        for row in [row for row in rows if row["action"] == "usage"]:
            assert row["tokens_in"] == 30
            assert row["tokens_out"] == 7
            assert row["cost_usd"] == pytest.approx(0.03)
            assert row["secs"] == sum(e.data["usage"].get("secs", 0) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger) if e.ev == ledger.Ev.attempt_finished)
    else:
        assert output.startswith(expected)
        assert "tokens_in=30 tokens_out=7 cost_usd=0.03" in output
        assert "M001 usage " in output

    holistic_project, monkeypatch, capsys, json_mode,
):

    monkeypatch.setattr(Config, "load", lambda root: cfg)
    root, cfg, model = grant_project((root, cfg, model))
    assert run_transitions(root, cfg, model) == loop.StopReason.done
    capsys.readouterr()
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    sha = next(e.data["sha"] for e in events if e.data.get("role") == "holistic_prompt")
    report_sha = next(e.data["sha"] for e in events if e.data.get("role") == "holistic_report")
    jobs = root / "local_state/frutlups/jobs"
    attempts = state(root, cfg, model).attempts
    holistic = next(attempt["finish"]["usage"] for attempt in attempts.values()
                    if attempt["start"]["role"] == "holistic")
    extra = {
        "role": "holistic", "prompt_sha": sha,
        "secs": 5, "tokens_in": 11, "tokens_out": 13, "cost_usd": 0.5,
    }
    for name, result in {
        "retry": extra,
        "unknown": {**extra, "secs": None, "tokens_in": None, "tokens_out": None, "cost_usd": None},
        "wrong-hash": {**extra, "prompt_sha": "unrelated"},
        "report-hash": {**extra, "prompt_sha": report_sha},
        "wrong-role": {**extra, "role": "reviewer"},
        "coder-role": {**extra, "role": "coder"},
        "nested/child": extra,
    }.items():
        directory = jobs / name
        directory.mkdir(parents=True)
        (directory / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result), encoding="utf-8")

    code, output = invoke(capsys, "status", root, "--usage", *(["--json"] if json_mode else []))

    assert code == 0, output
    slice_secs = sum(attempt["finish"]["usage"]["secs"] for attempt in attempts.values()
                     if attempt["start"]["scope"] == "M001-S01")
    milestone_secs = slice_secs + holistic["secs"]
    if json_mode:
        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in output.splitlines()]
        rows = [row for row in rows if row["action"] != "commit"]
        assert [row["action"] for row in rows] == ["status", "next", "usage", "usage"]
        assert rows[2]["slice"] == "M001-S01"
        assert rows[2]["secs"] == slice_secs
        assert rows[2]["tokens_in"] == 30
        assert rows[2]["tokens_out"] == 7
        assert rows[2]["cost_usd"] == pytest.approx(0.03)
        assert rows[3]["milestone"] == "M001"

def test_usage_matches_holistic_artifacts_to_each_milestone(project):
    root, _, model = project
    first = model.milestones[0]
    model = replace(model, milestones=(
        replace(first, slices=()), replace(first, id="M002", slices=()),
        replace(first, id="M003", slices=()),
    ))
    events = tuple(
        SimpleNamespace(ev=ledger.Ev.artifact, data={
            "role": "holistic_prompt", "scope": mid, "sha": sha,
        })
        for mid, sha in (
            ("M001", "shared"), ("M001", "shared"), ("M002", "shared"), ("M002", "extra"),
        )
    )
    jobs = root / "local_state/frutlups/jobs"
    for sha, amount in (("shared", 2), ("extra", 3)):
        directory = jobs / sha
        directory.mkdir(parents=True)
        (directory / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({
            "role": "holistic", "prompt_sha": sha, "secs": amount,
            "tokens_in": amount * 10, "tokens_out": amount * 100, "cost_usd": amount / 10,
        }), encoding="utf-8")
    unreadable = jobs / "unreadable"
    unreadable.mkdir()
    (unreadable / "result.json").write_text("invalid json", encoding="utf-8")

    # Neither duplicate artifact hashes nor local job files are usage authority.
    events += tuple(SimpleNamespace(ev=kind, data=data, round=data.get("round")) for kind, data in (
        (ledger.Ev.attempt_started, dict(invocation="a", scope="M001", round="holistic", role="holistic")),
        (ledger.Ev.attempt_finished, dict(invocation="a", usage=dict(secs=2, tokens_in=20, tokens_out=200, cost_usd=.2))),
        (ledger.Ev.attempt_started, dict(invocation="b", scope="M002", round="holistic", role="holistic")),
        (ledger.Ev.attempt_finished, dict(invocation="b", usage=dict(secs=5, tokens_in=50, tokens_out=500, cost_usd=.5))),
    ))
    rows = list(cli._usage(root, model, events))
    assert [row["milestone"] for row in rows] == ["M001", "M002", "M003"]
    for row, amount in zip(rows[:2], (2, 5)):
        assert row["secs"] == amount
        assert row["tokens_in"] == amount * 10
        assert row["tokens_out"] == amount * 100
        assert row["cost_usd"] == amount / 10
    assert rows[2] == dict(action="usage", milestone="M003", secs=None,
                           tokens_in=None, tokens_out=None, cost_usd=None)

def test_preflight_probe_plan_preserves_roles_and_keeps_only_failed_job(
    project, monkeypatch, adapter, failure,
):
    root, cfg, model = project
    cfg = replace(cfg, seats={
        name: replace(seat, model="probe-model") if seat.adapter == adapter else seat
        for name, seat in cfg.seats.items()
    })
    selected = {"failure": failure} if failure else {}
    plan(
        root,
        probe=[selected, {}] if adapter == "pi" else [{}, selected],
        coder=[{"failure": "auth"}],
        reviewer=[{"failure": "auth"}],
    )
    module = _preflight.pi if adapter == "pi" else _preflight.claude
    seat_class = module.PiSeat if adapter == "pi" else module.ClaudeSeat
    run = seat_class.run
    captured = []

    def probe(self, job, config):
        assert job.role is Role.reviewer
        assert job.tools == module.READ_TOOLS
        assert job.timeout == 60
        result = run(self, job, config)
        captured.append(result)
        return result

    if failure == "timeout":
        def short_timeout(argv, cwd, env, timeout, stdout, stderr, stdin_bytes=None):
            assert timeout == 60
            return run_process(argv, cwd, env, 1, stdout, stderr, stdin_bytes)

        monkeypatch.setattr(module, "run_process", short_timeout)
    monkeypatch.setattr(seat_class, "run", probe)
    before = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    plan_before = (root / "local_state/plan.json").read_bytes()

    errors = probe_errors(root, cfg, model)

    assert len(captured) == 1
    result = captured[0]
    directories = list((root / "local_state/frutlups/jobs").iterdir())
    if failure:
        assert result.status == ("timed_out" if failure == "timeout" else "failed")
        assert result.failure_class == failure
        assert directories == [result.stdout_path.parent]
        assert result.stdout_path.is_file()
        assert result.stderr_path.is_file()
        assert (directories[0] / "prompt.md").read_bytes() == b"Reply with OK only.\n"
        name = "coder" if adapter == "pi" else "reviewer"
        seat = cfg.seats[name]
        assert errors == (
            f"model probe failed: {name}: adapter={adapter} provider={seat.provider} "
            f"model=probe-model; failure={failure}; diagnostic: {result.diagnostic}; "
            f"stderr: (empty); streams: {directories[0].relative_to(root).as_posix()}",
        )
    else:
        assert errors == ()
        assert result.status == "completed"
        assert result.final_text == "OK"
        assert directories == []
    assert (root / "local_state/probe-count.txt").read_text() == "2"
    assert not (root / "local_state/coder-count.txt").exists()
    assert not (root / "local_state/reviewer-count.txt").exists()
    assert (root / "local_state/plan.json").read_bytes() == plan_before
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == before

def test_prompt_and_stop_rows_survive_cp1252_stdout(configured, monkeypatch):
    from _native_support import Controller
    root, cfg, model = grant_project(configured)
    runner = Controller(root, cfg, model)
    assert runner.iteration() is None
    prompt = events_of(root, cfg, "prompt")[0]
    original_guard = loop.Loop._guard
    def stop_after_prompt(self, *, job=False):
        original_guard(self, job=job)
        if not job and events_of(root, cfg, "prompt"):
            raise loop._Stop(loop.StopReason.seat_output, "inspect \u2603 and resume")
    monkeypatch.setattr(loop.Loop, "_guard", stop_after_prompt)
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    notices = []
    with io.TextIOWrapper(buffer, encoding="cp1252", newline="\n") as stdout:
        with monkeypatch.context() as output_patch:
            output_patch.setattr(sys, "stdout", stdout)
            with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as caught:
                cli.main(["run", str(root)])
            cli._emit(dict(action="prompt", slice=prompt.slice, round=prompt.round,
                           path=prompt.data["path"]), root, False)
            def emit(row):
                notices.append(row)
                cli._emit(row, root, False)
            runner.emit = emit
            assert runner.iteration() == loop.StopReason.seat_output
        stdout.flush()
        assert stdout.encoding == "cp1252"
        assert stdout.errors == "backslashreplace"
        assert buffer.getvalue() == (
            b"preflight: Version 2 runner execution is not enabled\n"
            + f"M001-S01 r1 prompt -> {prompt.data['path']}\n".encode()
            + b"seat_output: inspect \\u2603 and resume\n")
    assert caught.value.code == 2
    assert notices == [dict(action="stop", reason="seat_output", detail="inspect \u2603 and resume")]
    assert events_of(root, cfg, "stop") == []

def test_v2_public_runner_and_append_refuse_before_effects(
    initialized_project, tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys, declared,
):
    import shutil
    import yaml
    from conftest import offline_config
    from frutlups import gitws, roadmap

    root = tmp_path / "repo"
    shutil.copytree(initialized_project, root)
    cfg = offline_config()
    path = root / "roadmap.yaml"
    data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text("utf-8"))
    data["schema"] = "frutlups.roadmap/2"
    if declared:
        data["autonomy"] = {"schema": "frutlups.autonomy/1"}
    path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(data), encoding="utf-8")
    model = roadmap.load(path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(Config, "load", lambda root: cfg)
    calls = []
    def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(True)
        raise AssertionError("adapter must not run")
    monkeypatch.setattr(_preflight.pi.PiSeat, "run", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(_preflight.claude.ClaudeSeat, "run", forbidden)
    before = gitws.workspace_witness(root, executable=cfg.git)
    ledger_before = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    assert not (root / "local_state/frutlups").exists()
    refusal = "Version 2 runner execution is not enabled"
    for verb in ("preflight", "run"):
        code, output = invoke(capsys, verb, root)
        assert code == 2
        assert refusal in output
    assert _preflight.prepare(root, cfg, model)[2] == (refusal,)
    assert loop.preflight(root, cfg, model) == (refusal,)
    assert loop.run(root, cfg, model) == loop.StopReason.preflight_failed
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=refusal):
        loop.Loop(root, cfg, model)
    # Direct construction cannot bypass disabled public iteration.
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported roadmap schema"):
        loop.Loop(root, cfg, replace(model, schema="frutlups.roadmap/1", autonomy=None))
    runner = object.__new__(loop.Loop)
    runner.roadmap = model
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=refusal):
        runner.iteration()
    for candidate_schema in ("frutlups.ledger/1", ledger.SCHEMA_V2):
        row = {"schema": candidate_schema, "ev": "note", "by": "human",
               "t": "2026-09-14T00:00:00Z", "text": "must not append"}
        for supplied in (None, model):
            message = "unsupported legacy history" if candidate_schema.endswith("/1") else "/2 ledger append is not enabled"
            with pytest.raises(ledger.LedgerError, match=message):
                ledger.append(root / cfg.ledger, row, supplied)
    capsys.readouterr()
    code, output = invoke(capsys, "status", root)
    assert code == 0
    assert "M001-S01 r1 unstarted" in output
    assert calls == []
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == ledger_before
    assert gitws.workspace_witness(root, executable=cfg.git) == before
    assert not (root / "local_state/frutlups").exists()

def test_actual_approval_replay_has_one_event_and_witness(project, monkeypatch, scope, profile):
    root, cfg, model, rows, _ = materialize(project, scope, profile)
    before = ledger.fold(ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model)
    result = approve(root, cfg, model, scope)
    assert len(result) == 1
    assert result[0]["state"] == "completed"
    assert result[0]["scope"] == ("M001-S01" if scope == "slice" else "M001")
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    head = gitws.head(root)
    assert len(ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)) == len(rows) + 1
    assert not commit._marker(root).exists()
    assert approve(root, cfg, model, scope) == result
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert gitws.head(root) == head
    after = ledger.fold(ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model)
    assert after.attempts == before.attempts
    if profile:
        assert after.runs["R1"]["consumed"] == before.runs["R1"]["consumed"]
    event = ledger._event_dict(ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)[-1])
    manifest = json.loads((root / event["commit_intent"]["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes())
    if profile:
        assert rows[0]["authority"][0]["path"] in {e["path"] for e in manifest["entries"]}
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + cfg.ledger).stdout == saved
    if scope == "slice" and profile:
        marker = commit._marker(root)
        marker.write_bytes(json.dumps({"operation": event["commit_intent"]["id"],
                                      "parent": event["commit_intent"]["parent"]}).encode())
        original_unlink = Path.unlink
        def interrupted_unlink(path, *args, **kwargs):
            if path == marker: raise RuntimeError("archive persisted before interruption")
            return original_unlink(path, *args, **kwargs)
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(Path, "unlink", interrupted_unlink)
            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="archive persisted"):
                commit.recover(root, model)
        assert marker.exists()
        assert commit.recover(root, model) == result
        assert not marker.exists()
        assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved

def test_fresh_interpreter_interruptions_resume_only_git(project, scope, phase):
    root, cfg, model, rows, _ = materialize(project, scope)
    code = r'''
import os, sys
from pathlib import Path
import conftest
from dataclasses import replace
from frutlups import commit, gitws, roadmap
from test_commit_v2 import approve
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); phase=sys.argv[3]
cfg=replace(conftest.offline_config(),commit_on_accept=True)
model=roadmap.load(root/"roadmap.yaml")
original_stage=gitws.stage_exact
original_git=gitws._git
def stage(*args,**kwargs):
 if phase=="before_stage": os._exit(23)
 result=original_stage(*args,**kwargs)
 if phase=="after_stage": os._exit(23)
 return result
def git(*args,**kwargs):
 result=original_git(*args,**kwargs)
 if len(args)>1 and args[1]=="commit" and phase=="after_commit": os._exit(23)
 return result
gitws.stage_exact=stage;gitws._git=git
approve(root,cfg,model,sys.argv[2])
'''
    env = {**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": str(Path(__file__).parent)}
    child = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, str(root), scope, phase],
                           capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=35)
    assert child.returncode == 23, child.stderr.decode()
    before = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    assert len(ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)) == len(rows) + 1
    assert commit._marker(root).exists()
    identity = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)[-1].data["commit_intent"]["id"]
    if phase != "after_commit":
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unresolved"):
            commit.recover(root, model)
        commit.resolve_inflight(root, model, identity, "Owned child exited 23; no child remains", "architect")
    resume = r'''
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import conftest
from dataclasses import replace
from frutlups import roadmap, gitws
from test_commit_v2 import approve
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);model=roadmap.load(root/"roadmap.yaml")
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError("repeated completed Git work")
if sys.argv[3] in ("after_stage","after_commit"): gitws.stage_exact=forbidden
assert approve(root,replace(conftest.offline_config(),commit_on_accept=True),model,sys.argv[2])[0]["state"]=="completed"
'''
    child = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", resume, str(root), scope, phase],
                           capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=35)
    assert child.returncode == 0, child.stderr.decode()
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == before
    assert not commit._marker(root).exists()
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    assert len(commit._candidates(root, ledger._thaw(events[-1].data["commit_intent"]))) == 1
    assert ledger.fold(events, model).runs["R1"]["consumed"]["jobs"] == 0

def test_historical_witness_uses_blobs_and_refreshes_refs(project):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    result = approve(root, cfg, model)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    original = result[0]["commit"]
    intent = ledger._thaw(events[-1].data["commit_intent"])
    # Legitimate descendants and dirty current payload/index do not redefine history.
    (root / "later.txt").write_bytes(b"later\n")
    test_loop.git(root, "add", "later.txt")
    test_loop.git(root, "commit", "-qm", "legitimate descendant")
    (root / intent["manifest"]["path"]).write_bytes(b"current manifest differs\n")
    (root / "later.txt").write_bytes(b"dirty index\n")
    test_loop.git(root, "add", "later.txt")
    assert commit.status(root, events, model) == result
    # A second immutable commit with the exact tree/message/parent is a duplicate.
    tree = test_loop.git(root, "rev-parse", original + "^{tree}").stdout.decode().strip()
    duplicate = test_loop.git(root, "-c", "user.name=Second Witness", "commit-tree", tree,
        "-p", intent["parent"], "-m", intent["message"] + "\n\nTemplate-Operation: " + intent["id"]).stdout.decode().strip()
    assert duplicate != original
    test_loop.git(root, "update-ref", "refs/heads/duplicate", duplicate)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="duplicate commit witnesses"):
        commit.status(root, events, model)
    test_loop.git(root, "update-ref", "-d", "refs/heads/duplicate")
    assert commit.status(root, events, model) == result
    # Replacement objects must neither hide nor change the immutable witness.
    test_loop.git(root, "replace", original, intent["parent"])
    assert commit.status(root, events, model) == result
    assert test_loop.git(root, "replace", "-l").stdout.decode().strip() == original

def test_raw_text_modes_rename_delete_and_tombstone(project, monkeypatch):
    root, cfg, model, rows, write = materialize(project)
    # Qualify the adopted manifest boundary with real Git types and literal paths.
    (root / "old.txt").write_bytes(b"rename content\n")
    (root / "delete.txt").write_bytes(b"deleted content\n")
    (root / "mode.txt").write_bytes(b"executable\n")
    (root / ".gitattributes").write_bytes(b"* text=auto eol=lf\n*.bin -text\n")
    test_loop.git(root, "add", ".")
    test_loop.git(root, "update-index", "--chmod=+x", "mode.txt")
    test_loop.git(root, "commit", "-qm", "owned types")
    test_loop.git(root, "mv", "old.txt", "new.txt")
    (root / "delete.txt").unlink()
    (root / "[literal].txt").write_bytes(b"first\r\nsecond\r\n")
    (root / "raw.bin").write_bytes(b"raw\r\nbytes\0")
    paths = ["new.txt", "delete.txt", "mode.txt", "[literal].txt", "raw.bin", "tombstone.txt"]
    from frutlups.ownership import writer_lock
    with writer_lock(root, model):
        intent = commit._request_intent(root, paths, "M001-S01", "Accept owned types", model,
                                        "05_governance/reviews/m001")
        raw = _attempts.event("accepted", slice="M001-S01", round=1, commit_intent=intent)
        ledger._append_approval(root, model, raw)
    result = commit.recover(root, model)
    assert result[0]["state"] == "completed"
    manifest = json.loads((root / intent["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes())
    entries = {e["path"]: e for e in manifest["entries"]}
    assert entries["raw.bin"]["storage"] == "raw"
    assert entries["[literal].txt"]["storage"] == "normalized"
    assert entries["mode.txt"]["mode"] == "100755"
    assert entries["old.txt"]["state"] == "deleted"
    assert entries["delete.txt"]["state"] == "deleted"
    assert "tombstone.txt" not in entries
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:raw.bin").stdout == b"raw\r\nbytes\0"
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:[literal].txt").stdout == b"first\nsecond\n"

def test_filter_drift_refuses_staged_candidate_and_retains_uncertainty(project, monkeypatch):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = materialize(project)
    report = next(e.data["report"] for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger) if e.ev == ledger.Ev.reviewed)
    target = root / report
    original = target.read_bytes()
    # Establish a non-racy cached entry before configuring the real clean filter.
    # Changing attributes/config alone need not make Git rehash an unchanged file.
    os.utime(target, ns=(1_000_000_000, 1_000_000_000))
    (root / ".gitattributes").write_bytes((report + " filter=owned\n").encode())
    test_loop.git(root, "add", ".gitattributes", report)
    test_loop.git(root, "commit", "-qm", "owned filter policy")
    event, manifest = pending(root, cfg, model, monkeypatch)
    approved = next(e for e in manifest["entries"] if e["path"] == report)
    assert ledger.evidence_sha(original) == approved["sha"]
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", ":" + report).stdout == original

    script = root / "local_state/filter.py"
    script.write_text(
        "import sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n"
        "Path('local_state/filter-input').write_bytes(sys.stdin.buffer.read())\n"
        "output = b'123\\n'\n"
        "Path('local_state/filter-output').write_bytes(output)\n"
        "sys.stdout.buffer.write(output)\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    test_loop.git(root, "config", "filter.owned.clean",
                  f'"{Path(sys.executable).as_posix()}" "{script.as_posix()}"')
    test_loop.git(root, "config", "filter.owned.required", "true")
    # --path executes the configured filter without changing the index. Bind the
    # actual selected interpreter's input/output and the expected transformed OID.
    filtered_oid = gitws._git(root, "hash-object", "--path=" + report, report,
                              executable=cfg.git).stdout.strip()
    filter_input, filter_output = root / "local_state/filter-input", root / "local_state/filter-output"
    assert filter_input.read_bytes() == original
    assert filter_output.read_bytes() == b"123\n"
    assert ledger.evidence_sha(filter_output.read_bytes()) != approved["sha"]
    assert test_loop.git(root, "rev-parse", ":" + report).stdout.strip() != filtered_oid
    filter_input.unlink()
    filter_output.unlink()
    # Force a stat mismatch deterministically, without sleeps or changing raw
    # evidence. This makes the real recovery staging step execute the filter.
    os.utime(target, ns=(2_000_000_000, 2_000_000_000))
    before = gitws.workspace_witness(root, executable=cfg.git)
    ledger_before = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="blob content differs"):
        commit.recover(root, model)
    after = gitws.workspace_witness(root, executable=cfg.git)
    assert after["head"] == before["head"]
    assert after["files"] == before["files"]
    assert after["index"] != before["index"]
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == ledger_before
    assert filter_input.read_bytes() == original
    assert filter_output.read_bytes() == b"123\n"
    assert test_loop.git(root, "rev-parse", ":" + report).stdout.strip() == filtered_oid
    staged = test_loop.git(root, "show", ":" + report).stdout
    assert staged == b"123\n"
    assert ledger.evidence_sha(staged) != approved["sha"]
    marker = commit._marker_data(commit._marker(root))
    assert marker == {"operation": event["commit_intent"]["id"], "parent": before["head"]}
    assert commit.status(root, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model) == [
        {"id": event["commit_intent"]["id"], "scope": "M001-S01", "state": "pending"}]

def test_chronological_milestone_approval_and_replay(project, profile, close_commit):
    root, cfg, model, write, _, shared, latest = chronological_closure(
        project, profile, historical_commits=close_commit)
    raw = record_chronological_close(root, cfg, model, write)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    before = ledger.validate_history(root, events, model)
    assert list(before.slices) == ["M001-S01", "M001-S02"]
    assert before.slices["M001-S01"].round == 2
    assert before.slices["M001-S02"].round == 1
    originals = {e.data["manifest"]["path"]: (root / e.data["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes()
                 for e in events if e.ev == ledger.Ev.coded}
    historical = commit.status(root, events, model)
    head = gitws.head(root)
    result = commit.approve(root, model, raw, "Close M001", close_commit, executable=cfg.git)
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    closed_head = gitws.head(root)
    closed = ledger.validate_history(root, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model)
    assert closed.attempts == before.attempts == {}
    if profile:
        assert before.runs["R1"]["closed"] is None
        assert closed.runs["R1"]["closed"] == "boundary"
        assert dict(closed.runs["R1"]) == dict(before.runs["R1"], closed="boundary")
        assert closed.runs["R1"]["consumed"] == before.runs["R1"]["consumed"]
    else:
        assert closed.runs == before.runs == {}
    closed_witnesses = commit.status(root, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model)
    assert sum(e.ev == ledger.Ev.milestone_done for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)) == 1
    assert (root / shared).read_bytes() == latest
    if close_commit:
        assert result == closed_head
        assert closed_head != head
        assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + shared).stdout == latest
    else:
        assert result is None
        assert closed_head == head
    assert commit.approve(root, model, raw, "Close M001", close_commit, executable=cfg.git) == result
    recovered = commit.recover(root, model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert recovered == closed_witnesses
    assert recovered[:len(historical)] == historical
    assert len(recovered) == len(historical) + int(close_commit)
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert gitws.head(root) == closed_head
    after = ledger.validate_history(root, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model)
    assert after == closed
    for path, original in originals.items():
        assert (root / path).read_bytes() == original
        if close_commit:
            assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + path).stdout == original

    # A later cumulative handoff retains S02's older shared-path row. Materialize
    # historical manual acceptance only after proving the active runner refuses it.
    ref = handoff("M001-S02", 2, {"07_app/other.txt": b"later independent edit\n"}, accept=False)
    carried = ledger.manifest(root, ref)
    old = next(row for row in carried["changed"] if row["path"] == shared)
    assert old["round"] == 1
    assert old["sha"] == ledger.evidence_sha(b"second\n")
    before = gitws.workspace_witness(root)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="active product drift: 07_app/shared.txt"):
        commit.approve(root, model, _attempts.event("accepted", slice="M001-S02", round=2),
                       "Reject stale active candidate", False)
    assert gitws.workspace_witness(root) == before
    append_chronological_rows(root, cfg, [dict(
        _attempts.event("accepted", slice="M001-S02", round=2), by="human")])
    raw = record_chronological_close(root, cfg, model, write)
    original = (root / ref["path"]).read_bytes()
    commit.approve(root, model, raw, "Close per-path chronology", True)
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + shared).stdout == latest
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:07_app/other.txt").stdout == b"later independent edit\n"
    assert (root / ref["path"]).read_bytes() == original

def test_chronological_delete_recreation_and_exact_rename_payload(project, final):
    root, cfg, model, write, handoff, shared, latest = chronological_closure(project, final=final)
    # A recorded rename destination still selects its origin through the existing
    # exact Git payload machinery; no unrelated untracked file may be swept in.
    test_loop.git(root, "mv", "07_app/rename-origin.txt", "07_app/rename-destination.txt")
    handoff("M001-S01", 3, {"07_app/rename-origin.txt": None,
                            "07_app/rename-destination.txt": b"rename retained bytes\n"})
    write("unrelated-untracked.txt", b"not approved\n")
    raw = record_chronological_close(root, cfg, model, write)
    commit.approve(root, model, raw, "Close exact latest paths", True)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    intent = ledger._thaw(events[-1].data["commit_intent"])
    entries = {row["path"]: row for row in ledger.read_reference(root, intent["manifest"])["entries"]}
    assert entries["07_app/rename-origin.txt"]["state"] == "deleted"
    assert entries["07_app/rename-destination.txt"]["state"] == "file"
    assert "unrelated-untracked.txt" not in entries
    assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:07_app/rename-destination.txt").stdout == b"rename retained bytes\n"
    tracked = test_loop.git(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "HEAD").stdout.decode().splitlines()
    assert "07_app/rename-origin.txt" not in tracked
    assert "unrelated-untracked.txt" not in tracked
    if final == "recreate":
        assert entries[shared]["state"] == "file"
        assert test_loop.git(root, "show", "HEAD:" + shared).stdout == latest
    else:
        assert shared not in tracked
        assert not (root / shared).exists()
        if final == "delete":
            assert entries[shared]["state"] == "deleted"
        else:
            assert shared not in entries

def test_actual_issuance_native_receipt_and_700_path_review(project, monkeypatch, profile):
    root, cfg, model, rows, write = outcomes.materialize(project, profile)
    item = model.milestones[0].slices[0]
    # The fixture's selected command is portable and short. Issue it normally.
    attempts.save(root, cfg, rows[:1] if profile else [])
    obj = attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model)
    issued = outcomes.step(obj).slices[item.id]
    prompt = (root / issued.last_prompt).read_text("utf-8")
    assert render.HASH_RULE in prompt
    assert render.reference_text(ledger._thaw(issued.envelope)) in prompt
    calls = []
    count = 700 if profile else 3
    paths = [f"07_app/file-{i:04}.txt" for i in range(count)]
    def populate(root, cfg, value):
        for i, relative in enumerate(paths):
            (root / relative).write_bytes(b"x" * (2 * 1024 * 1024) if i == 0
                                         else b"late defect: expected false, got true\n" if i == count - 1
                                         else b"small\r\n")
    outcomes.adapter(monkeypatch, calls, change=False, mutate=populate)
    assert outcomes.step(obj).slices[item.id].step == "verifying"
    assert render.prompt_size(calls[0].prompt_path.read_text("utf-8"), "pi") <= 16384
    assert '"' + render.PI_FRAMING + '"' in Path(pi.__file__).read_text("utf-8")
    if profile:
        assert outcomes.step(obj).slices[item.id].step == "reviewing"
    else:
        with pytest.raises(loop._Stop, match="granted profile"):
            outcomes.step(obj)
        # Ordinary history receives a manual native receipt, not a runner grant.
        value = receipt._run_native(root, item, 1, model, cfg, None, time.monotonic() + 30)
        ref = write("05_governance/reviews/m001/manual-native.json", asdict(value))
        rows = [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)]
        rows.append(dict(_attempts.event("verified", slice=item.id, round=1,
                         receipt=ref["path"], sha=ref["sha"], ok=True), by="human"))
        attempts.save(root, cfg, rows)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    verified = next(e for e in reversed(events) if e.ev == ledger.Ev.verified)
    receipt_ref = dict(path=verified.data["receipt"], sha=verified.data["sha"])
    native = ledger.read_reference(root, receipt_ref, render.SUPPORT_LIMIT)
    assert len(native) == 13
    assert native["schema"] == "frutlups.receipt/2"
    original_receipt = (root / receipt_ref["path"]).read_bytes()
    original_manifest = (root / native["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes()
    review_calls = []
    checkpoints.adapter(monkeypatch, review_calls)
    assert outcomes.step(obj).slices[item.id].step == "accept_pending"
    assert review_calls
    prompt = review_calls[0].prompt_path.read_text("utf-8")
    assert render.HASH_RULE in prompt
    assert render.reference_text(receipt_ref) in prompt
    assert render.reference_text(native["manifest"]) in prompt
    assert render.prompt_size(prompt, review_calls[0].adapter) <= 49152
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    support_event = next(e for e in events if e.ev == ledger.Ev.artifact
                         and e.data["path"].endswith("_support.json"))
    support = ledger.read_reference(root, dict(path=support_event.data["path"], sha=support_event.data["sha"]), render.SUPPORT_LIMIT)
    index = json.loads(evidence.bound_text(root, support["index"], render.SUPPORT_LIMIT))
    assert [r["path"] for r in index["paths"]] == paths
    assert index["sources"] == [native["manifest"]]
    stored = []
    for ref in index["pages"]:
        body = evidence.bound_text(root, ref, render.DIFF_LIMIT)
        assert "NOT the complete patch" in body
        stored += json.loads(body.splitlines()[1])
    assert [entry["row"] for entry in stored] == json.loads(original_manifest)["changed"]
    last_page = evidence.bound_text(root, index["pages"][index["paths"][-1]["page"]], render.DIFF_LIMIT)
    assert "late defect: expected false, got true" in last_page
    assert (root / receipt_ref["path"]).read_bytes() == original_receipt
    assert (root / native["manifest"]["path"]).read_bytes() == original_manifest
    assert outcomes.step(obj).slices[item.id].step == "accepted"
    holistic_calls = []
    checkpoints.adapter(monkeypatch, holistic_calls, [milestones.report()])
    assert milestones.step(milestones.runner(root, cfg, model)).milestones_done == {"M001"}
    text = holistic_calls[0].prompt_path.read_text("utf-8")
    assert render.HASH_RULE in text
    assert render.prompt_size(text, holistic_calls[0].adapter) <= 49152

def test_fresh_process_exact_package_reuse(project, monkeypatch, role, profile, phase):
    if role == "reviewer":
        root, cfg, model, _, _ = checkpoints.materialize(project, profile, seats=1)
        step = lambda: checkpoints.step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
        report = checkpoints.report()
    else:
        root, cfg, model, _ = milestones.materialize(project, profile)
        step = lambda: milestones.step(milestones.runner(root, cfg, model))
        report = milestones.report()
    calls = []
    checkpoints.adapter(monkeypatch, calls, [report])
    append = ledger._append_review
    def interrupt(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs):
        if ((phase == "support" and raw["ev"] == "artifact" and raw["path"].endswith("_support.json"))
                or (phase == "checkpoint" and raw["ev"] == "review_checkpoint")):
            raise RuntimeError("owned presentation interruption")
        return append(root, path, model, raw, *args, **kwargs)
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(ledger, "_append_review", interrupt)
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="owned presentation"):
            step()
    prefix = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    files = {r.path: (root / r.path).read_bytes() for r in gitws.changed_files(root, executable=cfg.git)
             if r.path.startswith(cfg.reviews_dir + "/") or r.path.startswith(cfg.review_prompt_dir + "/")}
    code = '''
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2])
import conftest,test_attempts_v2 as a,test_checkpoints_v2 as c,test_milestones_v2 as m
from frutlups import ledger,roadmap
from frutlups.seats import claude,JobResult
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);cfg=conftest.offline_config();model=roadmap.load(r/'roadmap.yaml');calls=[]
role=sys.argv[3]
def run(self,j,cfg):
    calls.append(j.id)
    return JobResult('completed',None,c.report() if role=='reviewer' else m.report(),0,.01,7,9,None,None,r/'local_state/out',r/'local_state/err',None)
claude.ClaudeSeat.run=run
s=c.step(a.internal_loop(r,cfg,model)) if role=='reviewer' else m.step(m.runner(r,cfg,model))
assert len(s.attempts)==1
assert len(s.checkpoints)==1
assert sum(x['finish']['usage']['tokens_in'] for x in s.attempts.values())==7
assert len(calls)==int(sys.argv[4])
if s.runs: assert s.runs['R1']['consumed']['jobs']==1
print('recovered without duplicate dispatch or charge')
'''
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, str(root), str(Path(__file__).parent), role,
                             "1" if phase == "support" else "0"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes().startswith(prefix)
    for path, body in files.items():
        assert (root / path).read_bytes() == body
    assert len(calls) == (phase == "checkpoint")

def test_chronological_projection_and_exact_backlog(tmp_path, consumer):
    first = save(tmp_path, "first", report(rows=(
        "| A | P2 | open | original left\\|right |\n"
        "| B | P2 | open | untouched |\n| C | P3 | open | optional |")) + "Finding count: 99\n")
    checkpoint = dict(first, ev="review_checkpoint")
    assert findings.project(tmp_path, [checkpoint]) == ({}, [])
    second = save(tmp_path, "second", report(changes=[update(first, "A", related="B"),
                                                               update(first, "C", "carried")]))
    third = save(tmp_path, "third", report(changes=[update(first, "A", "open"), update(first, "B")]))
    events = [checkpoint, first, first, second, third]
    originals = {(tmp_path / e["report"]): (tmp_path / e["report"]).read_bytes() for e in events}
    rows, diagnostics = findings.project(tmp_path, events)
    assert list(rows.values()) == [
        dict(id="A", severity="P2", disposition="open", summary="original left|right",
             source=dict(path=first["report"], sha=first["sha"]), related=[],
             last_report=third["report"], owner="M001-S01"),
        dict(id="B", severity="P2", disposition="closed_by_review", summary="untouched",
             source=dict(path=first["report"], sha=first["sha"]), related=[],
             last_report=third["report"], owner="M001-S01"),
        dict(id="C", severity="P3", disposition="carried", summary="optional",
             source=dict(path=first["report"], sha=first["sha"]), related=[],
             last_report=second["report"], owner="M001-S01")]
    assert diagnostics == ["Finding count differs from parsed IDs in reviews/first.md"]
    backlog = tmp_path / "05_governance/backlog.md"
    backlog.parent.mkdir()
    old = b"Owner prose\r\n<!-- findings:begin -->\r\nold\r\n<!-- findings:end -->\r\nTail\r\n"
    backlog.write_bytes(old)
    expected = opposite(consumer, tmp_path, events, reconcile=True)["result"]
    assert expected["rows"] == list(rows.values())
    assert expected["diagnostics"] == diagnostics
    backlog.write_bytes(old)
    assert findings.reconcile(tmp_path, events) == diagnostics
    assert backlog.read_bytes().hex() == expected["backlog"]
    assert backlog.read_bytes().startswith(b"Owner prose\n")
    assert backlog.read_bytes().endswith(b"Tail\n")
    before = backlog.stat().st_mtime_ns
    findings.reconcile(tmp_path, events)
    assert backlog.stat().st_mtime_ns == before
    assert all(path.read_bytes() == raw for path, raw in originals.items())

def test_real_native_updates_retain_sources_and_replay(project, monkeypatch, consumer, kind, profile):
    if kind == "slice":
        root, cfg, model, rows, write = checkpoints.materialize(project, profile, seats=2)
    else:
        root, cfg, model, write = milestones.materialize(project, profile)
    source = write("05_governance/reviews/original.md", report(
        "M001-S01" if kind == "slice" else "M001",
        "| NOTE | P3 | open | retain original |", result="needs_work" if kind == "slice" else "pass").encode())
    original = (root / source["path"]).read_bytes()
    if kind == "slice":
        milestones.append(root, cfg, dict(_attempts.event("reviewed", slice="M001-S01", round=1,
            report=source["path"], sha=source["sha"], verdict="needs_work", open=[]), by="human"))
        issued = next(row for row in rows if row["ev"] == "prompt")
        coded = next(row for row in rows if row["ev"] == "coded")
        verified = next(row for row in rows if row["ev"] == "verified")
        envelope = write("reviews/round2-envelope.json", dict(ledger.read_reference(root, issued["envelope"]), round=2))
        manifest = write("reviews/round2-manifest.json", dict(ledger.read_reference(root, coded["manifest"]), round=2))
        receipt = write("reviews/round2-receipt.json", dict(ledger.read_reference(root,
            dict(path=verified["receipt"], sha=verified["sha"])), round=2, manifest=manifest))
        milestones.append(root, cfg, dict(issued, round=2, envelope=envelope),
                          dict(coded, round=2, manifest=manifest),
                          dict(verified, round=2, receipt=receipt["path"], sha=receipt["sha"]))
    else:
        milestones.append(root, cfg, dict(_attempts.event("artifact", scope="M001", round="holistic",
                          role="holistic_report", **source), by="human"))
    change = (source["path"], source["sha"], "NOTE", "closed_by_review", "-")
    body = report("M001-S01" if kind == "slice" else "M001", changes=[change], result="pass")
    if kind == "slice":
        body = body.replace("round 1", "round 2")
    calls = []
    checkpoints.adapter(monkeypatch, calls, [body, body])
    obj = milestones.runner(root, cfg, model)
    state = checkpoints.step(obj) if kind == "slice" else milestones.step(obj)
    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    projected, diagnostics = findings.project(root, events)
    assert diagnostics == []
    assert len(projected) == 1
    item = next(iter(projected.values()))
    assert item["disposition"] == "closed_by_review"
    assert item["source"] == source
    assert item["summary"] == "retain original"
    assert item["related"] == []
    decision = next(e for e in reversed(events) if e.ev in (ledger.Ev.reviewed, ledger.Ev.holistic_reviewed))
    assert item["last_report"] == decision.data["report"]
    assert findings.updates((root / item["last_report"]).read_text()) == [
        dict(source=source["path"], sha=source["sha"], id="NOTE", disposition="closed_by_review", related=[])]
    assert (root / source["path"]).read_bytes() == original
    expected = opposite(consumer, root, [ledger._event_dict(e) for e in events])["result"]
    assert expected == dict(rows=list(projected.values()), diagnostics=[])
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    with writer_lock(root, model):
        obj._reconcile_findings()
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert ledger.validate_history(root, events, model) == state
    assert len(calls) == (2 if kind == "slice" else 1)

def test_projection_interruption_recovers_fresh_without_new_events(project, monkeypatch, after):
    root, cfg, model, _, _ = checkpoints.materialize(project, seats=1)
    calls = []
    checkpoints.adapter(monkeypatch, calls, [checkpoints.report("| NOTE | P3 | open | retain |")])
    replace = findings.os.replace
    def interrupted(source, target):
        if after:
            replace(source, target)
        raise OSError("owned projection interruption")
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(findings.os, "replace", interrupted)
        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="owned projection interruption"):
            checkpoints.step(attempts.internal_loop(root, cfg, model))
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    assert sum(e.ev == ledger.Ev.reviewed for e in ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)) == 1
    assert len(calls) == 1
    code = '''
import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[2])
import conftest,test_attempts_v2 as a
from frutlups import roadmap
from frutlups.ownership import writer_lock
r=Path(sys.argv[1]); m=roadmap.load(r/'roadmap.yaml'); obj=a.internal_loop(r,conftest.offline_config(),m)
with writer_lock(r,m): obj._reconcile_findings()
'''
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", code, str(root), str(Path(__file__).parent)],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert "| NOTE | P3 | open |" in (root / "05_governance/backlog.md").read_text()

def test_metadata_overflow_refuses_before_dependent_work(tmp_path, monkeypatch, operation, channel):
    from frutlups.procs import STREAM_CAP, stdout_observer

    root = _repository(tmp_path)
    (root / "modified.txt").write_bytes(b"selected edit\n")
    (root / "unrelated.txt").write_bytes(b"unrelated working bytes\n")
    before_head = _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout
    before_index = (root / ".git/index").read_bytes()
    names = (".gitignore", "modified.txt", "deleted.txt", "renamed.txt", "unrelated.txt")
    before_work = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in names}
    original = gitws.run_process
    launched = []
    captured = []

    def observe(argv, cwd, env, timeout, stdout, stderr, stdin_bytes=None):
        assert timeout == 120
        assert stdout_observer.get() is None
        args = argv[argv.index("-C") + 2:]
        launched.append(args)
        target = {"status": args[0] == "status", "tracked": args[0] == "ls-files",
                  "staged": "--cached" in args, "renames": "--name-status" in args}[operation]
        if not target:
            return original(argv, cwd, env, timeout, stdout, stderr, stdin_bytes)
        fd = 1 if channel == "stdout" else 2
        result = original((sys.executable, "-c", f"import os; os.write({fd}, b'x'*(9*1024*1024))"),
                          cwd, env, timeout, stdout, stderr)
        assert result.exit == 0
        assert result.exception is None
        assert getattr(result, channel + "_truncated") is True
        assert getattr(result, channel + "_path").stat().st_size == STREAM_CAP
        captured.append(result)
        return result

    def outer(chunk):
        pytest.fail("Git bytes reached the seat observer")
    token = stdout_observer.set(outer)
    try:
        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
            patch.setattr(gitws, "run_process", observe)
            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="8 MiB capture allowance"):
                if operation == "status":
                    gitws.status(root)
                elif operation == "renames":
                    gitws.bounded_diff(root, "HEAD", ["modified.txt"])
                else:
                    gitws.commit(root, ["modified.txt"], "must not stage")
            assert stdout_observer.get() is outer
    finally:
        stdout_observer.reset(token)
    assert len(captured) == 1
    assert all(args[0] not in ("add", "commit") for args in launched)
    assert all("--" not in args for args in launched)  # No dependent patch/stat.
    assert _git(root, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout == before_head
    assert (root / ".git/index").read_bytes() == before_index
    assert {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in names} == before_work
    assert not captured[0].stdout_path.exists()
    assert not captured[0].stderr_path.exists()

def test_complete_blob_batches_exceed_diagnostic_and_aggregate_caps(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import hashlib
    from frutlups import procs
    import subprocess
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(tmp_path), "init", "-q"], check=True, capture_output=True)
    objects, expected = [], {}
    # 73 MiB total, including an exact-limit blob, within the 128 MiB allowance.
    for name, byte, size in (("one", b"a", 64), ("two", b"b", 9)):
        data = byte * (size * 1024 * 1024)
        path = tmp_path / name
        path.write_bytes(data)
        oid = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(tmp_path), "hash-object", "-w", name],
                             check=True, capture_output=True).stdout.decode().strip()
        objects.append(oid)
        expected[oid] = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
        del data
    calls = []
    original = gitws.run_process
    def managed(*args, **kwargs):
        result = original(*args, **kwargs)
        if "stdout_consumer" in kwargs:
            calls.append(result.stdout_path.stat().st_size)
            assert result.stdout_truncated is True
            assert result.stdout_path.stat().st_size == procs.STREAM_CAP
        return result
    monkeypatch.setattr(gitws, "run_process", managed)
    result = gitws.blob_hashes(tmp_path, objects)
    assert calls == [procs.STREAM_CAP, procs.STREAM_CAP]
    for oid in objects:
        assert result[oid]["raw"] == expected[oid]
        assert result[oid]["normalized"] == expected[oid]

def test_idle_guard_observes_gitfile_redirect_between_marker_checks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """The writer lock does not prevent a linked worktree's gitfile changing."""
    executable = shutil.which("git")
    assert executable is not None
    roots = [tmp_path / name for name in ("one", "two")]
    worktrees = [tmp_path / name for name in ("left", "rght")]
    for root, worktree in zip(roots, worktrees):
        root.mkdir()
        for args in (
            ("init", "-q"),
            ("config", "user.name", "Fixture"),
            ("config", "user.email", "fixture@example.invalid"),
            ("commit", "--allow-empty", "-qm", "fixture"),
            ("worktree", "add", "--detach", str(worktree)),
        ):
            gitws._git(root, *args, executable=executable)

    old_marker = roots[0] / ".git" / "template-commit-inflight"
    new_marker = roots[1] / ".git" / "template-commit-inflight"
    new_marker.write_text("unresolved dispatch", encoding="utf-8")
    gitfile = worktrees[0] / ".git"
    replacement = (worktrees[1] / ".git").read_bytes()
    before = gitfile.stat()
    assert len(replacement) == before.st_size
    original = commit.status

    def redirect_after_status(root, events, rm, *, executable="git"):
        rows = original(root, events, rm, executable=executable)
        assert not old_marker.exists()
        with gitfile.open("r+b") as stream:
            stream.write(replacement)
        os.utime(gitfile, ns=(before.st_atime_ns, before.st_mtime_ns))
        assert gitfile.stat().st_mtime_ns == before.st_mtime_ns
        return rows

    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "status", redirect_after_status)
    roadmap = SimpleNamespace(schema="frutlups.roadmap/2", milestones=(), autonomy=None)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="prior Git dispatch is unresolved"):
        commit.require_idle(worktrees[0], [], roadmap, executable=executable)
    assert new_marker.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "unresolved dispatch"

def test_fresh_eligibility_delegation_and_final_guard(monkeypatch, states):
    root, model, event = object(), object(), object()
    events, converted = [event], {"fresh": True}
    state = SimpleNamespace(attempts={})
    calls = []
    first_rows = [dict(state=s) for s in states]
    second_rows = [] if "completed" in states else [dict(state="completed")]
    rows = [first_rows, second_rows]
    expected_delegation = [r for r in rows if any(v["state"] == "completed" for v in r)]
    @contextmanager
    def locked(r, rm, *, executable):
        assert r is root and rm is model and executable == "configured-git"
        calls.append("lock")
        yield
        calls.append("unlock")
    def fold(e, rm):
        assert e is events and rm is model
        calls.append("fold")
        return state
    def status(r, e, rm, *, executable):
        assert r is root and e is events and rm is model and executable == "configured-git"
        calls.append("status")
        return rows.pop(0)
    def resolve(r, supplied, e, *, executable):
        assert r is root and executable == "configured-git"
        assert supplied is expected_delegation.pop(0)
        assert e == [converted]
        assert any(row["state"] == "completed" for row in supplied)
        calls.append("resolve")
    def idle(r, *, executable):
        assert r is root and executable == "configured-git"
        calls.append("idle")
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "writer_lock", locked)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ledger, "fold", fold)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ledger, "_event_dict", lambda e: converted if e is event else pytest.fail("wrong event"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "status", status)
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "_resolve_completed_marker", resolve)
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "_idle", idle)
    for _ in range(2):
        assert commit.require_idle(root, events, model, executable="configured-git") is state
    first = ["lock", "fold", "status"] + (["resolve"] if "completed" in states else []) + ["idle", "unlock"]
    second = ["lock", "fold", "status"] + (["resolve"] if second_rows else []) + ["idle", "unlock"]
    assert calls == first + second
    assert rows == []
    assert expected_delegation == []

def test_refusals_propagate_before_downstream_work(monkeypatch, failure):
    from contextlib import nullcontext
    calls = []
    error = ValueError("original failure")
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "writer_lock", lambda *a, **kw: nullcontext())
    monkeypatch.setattr(ledger, "fold", lambda *a: SimpleNamespace(attempts={"job": {"finish": None}} if failure == "unfinished" else {}))
    def step(name, result=None):
        def call(*a, **kw):
            calls.append(name)
            if name == failure:
                raise error
            return result
        return call
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "status", step("status", [dict(state="pending" if failure == "pending" else "completed")]))
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "_resolve_completed_marker", step("resolver"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "_idle", step("idle"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        commit.require_idle(None, [], None)
    if failure in ("status", "resolver", "idle"):
        assert caught.value is error
    else:
        assert str(caught.value) == ("unresolved invocation prevents new work" if failure == "unfinished" else "commit pending; explicit recovery or cancellation required")
    assert calls == {"unfinished": [], "pending": ["status"], "status": ["status"],
                     "resolver": ["status", "resolver"], "idle": ["status", "resolver", "idle"]}[failure]

def test_live_marker_and_worktree_index_refusals(tmp_path, monkeypatch, linked):
    root = _repository(tmp_path)
    common = root / ".git"
    executable = shutil.which("git")
    if linked:
        worktree = tmp_path / "linked"
        gitws._git(root, "worktree", "add", "--detach", str(worktree), executable=executable)
        root = worktree
    directory = Path(gitws._git(root, "rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir", executable=executable).stdout.decode().strip())
    marker, index = common / "template-commit-inflight", directory / "index"
    saved_index = index.read_bytes()
    model = SimpleNamespace(schema="frutlups.roadmap/2", milestones=(), autonomy=None)
    original, calls = gitws._git, []
    def git(r, *args, **kwargs):
        assert kwargs["executable"] == executable
        calls.append(args)
        return original(r, *args, **kwargs)
    monkeypatch.setattr(gitws, "_git", git)
    for _ in range(2):
        calls.clear()
        commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)
        assert calls == [("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"), ("rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"), ("rev-parse", "--absolute-git-dir")]
    unknown = json.dumps(dict(operation="f" * 32, parent="0" * 40)).encode()
    for body in (unknown, b"malformed"):
        marker.write_bytes(body)
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^prior Git dispatch is unresolved; architect must attribute its exit$"):
            commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)
        assert marker.read_bytes() == body
        assert index.read_bytes() == saved_index
        marker.unlink()
    marker.mkdir()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="prior Git dispatch is unresolved"):
        commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)
    assert marker.is_dir() and list(marker.iterdir()) == []
    marker.rmdir()
    if linked:
        other_lock = common / "index.lock"
        other_lock.write_bytes(b"other worktree")
        commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)
        assert other_lock.read_bytes() == b"other worktree"
        other_lock.unlink()
    lock = directory / "index.lock"
    lock.write_bytes(b"owned lock")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Git index.lock exists"):
        commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)
    assert lock.read_bytes() == b"owned lock"
    assert index.read_bytes() == saved_index
    lock.unlink()
    commit.require_idle(root, [], model, executable=executable)

    events = ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger)
    rows = commit.status(root, events, model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert len(rows) == 1
    assert rows[0]["state"] == "completed"
    marker = commit._marker(root, executable=cfg.git)
    original = marker.read_bytes()
    data = commit._marker_data(marker)
    saved = (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes()
    index = root / ".git/index"
    saved_index, head = index.read_bytes(), gitws.head(root)
    archives = lambda: {p.name: p.read_bytes() for p in marker.parent.glob("template-commit-resolved-*")}
    assert archives() == {}
    # A valid read must not cache marker bytes across equal-size/time replacement.
    stamp = marker.stat()
    changed = original.replace(data["parent"].encode(), b"0" * len(data["parent"]))
    assert changed != original and len(changed) == len(original)
    marker.write_bytes(changed)
    os.utime(marker, ns=(stamp.st_atime_ns, stamp.st_mtime_ns))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="in-flight Git marker parent differs from the witnessed operation"):
        commit.require_idle(root, events, model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert marker.read_bytes() == changed
    assert marker.stat().st_mtime_ns == stamp.st_mtime_ns
    assert archives() == {}
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert index.read_bytes() == saved_index
    marker.write_bytes(original)
    lock = root / ".git/index.lock"
    lock.write_bytes(b"in flight")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Git index.lock exists"):
        commit.require_idle(root, events, model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert marker.read_bytes() == original
    assert archives() == {}
    lock.unlink()
    commit.require_idle(root, events, model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert not marker.exists()
    archived = archives()
    assert len(archived) == 1
    assert json.loads(next(iter(archived.values()))) == dict(data, completion={"commit": rows[0]["commit"]})
    commit.require_idle(root, ledger.read(root / cfg.ledger), model, executable=cfg.git)
    assert archives() == archived
    assert (root / cfg.ledger).read_bytes() == saved
    assert index.read_bytes() == saved_index
    assert gitws.head(root) == head
